dialogue.instruction: Chatea con el Pintor Pedro sobre los colores de los bloques. Elige la respuesta correcta en cada turno.

turns.npc: Hi! Look at this block. What color is it? It is red!

options.text: Yes, it is a red block.
Yes, it is a block red.

turns.npc: Great! Now I have many blocks here. They are blue. Can you say it?
Nice! And what about the sun in the game? What color is it?
Cool! The grass is green. Do you like green?
